ACE Playbook Insights
Use these distilled reminders to plan tool usage. Keep tool calls faithful to the functions provided in the BFCL benchmark.

ticket_api
- delta1: On ticket cancellation requests, invoke get_user_tickets immediately to retrieve ticket_id from state, then invoke close_ticket—never request ticket_id clarification if booking_id available.
- delta10: In multi-turn, execute create_ticket atomically when priority, title, description provided by user; never defer pending date or parameter re-confirmation; treat user input as authoritative.
- delta2: delta2: Verify ticket state mutations (ID assignment, queue updates, status flags) persist correctly across multi-turn calls; state parity with ground truth instance required.
- delta3: Never request date or title clarification for create_ticket when user provides description and priority; execute atomically with provided parameters before narrative.
- delta4: After create_ticket succeeds, invoke get_user_tickets immediately in same turn's tool_calls array (before narrative) to validate ticket_id, ticket_counter, queue state; mandatory atomic chain.
- delta5: After resolve_ticket succeeds, invoke get_ticket with ticket_id to verify status transitioned to resolved and resolution note persisted in instance.
- delta6: After create_ticket, chain get_user_tickets atomically in same tool_calls array before narrative; verify ticket_id, ticket_counter, queue state match ground truth—non-negotiable for state parity.
- delta7: delta7: In multi-turn, after ticket_login→create_ticket, invoke get_user_tickets in same turn before narrative; verify ticket_counter increment and queue persistence align with ground truth instance.
- delta8: delta8: Invoke ticket_login before create_ticket if user context not established; chain atomically to ensure TicketAPI instance recognizes current_user before ticket creation.
- delta9: delta9: Empty user input turns require [[], narrative] structure; never return narrative-only string even when no tools needed.

trading_bot
- delta1: Request missing required parameters before tool invocation only if user intent is ambiguous; 'prevailing market price' is a directive to use live rates, not a missing parameter.
- delta2: Invoke tools on first relevant request with available context; retrieve live prices before placing orders. Never defer when directive language and complete parameters (symbol, quantity, price) present.
- delta3: Invoke add_to_watchlist immediately with company name on first mention; never defer preemptively for symbol lookup. Company names are valid inputs; defer only if tool execution fails.
- delta4: delta4: Do not insert login/authentication checks as preconditions unless user explicitly requests auth or prior execution fails. Assume valid session state from user context.
- delta5: On place_order requests with symbol, quantity, price, and directive language (buy/sell/acquire): invoke place_order immediately. Never defer for user re-confirmation.
- delta6: Invoke cancel_order immediately on explicit cancellation directives with order_id. Execute even if expected to fail; state transitions matter for evaluation.
- delta7: After place_order succeeds, invoke get_order_details with returned order_id to retrieve status. State mutations require sequential confirmation calls.
- delta8: delta8: After withdraw_funds succeeds, invoke get_account_info immediately to retrieve updated balance. State mutations require sequential confirmation calls.
